script.title: Blood Relations: decode relation phrases
script.caption_hook: Mother's brother's son: is he your brother? Not quite!

lines.say: Mother's brother's son... is he my brother? I'm so confused!
Not a brother! Start from yourself and break it one link at a time.
One link at a time? How?
Learn these: father's father is grandfather, mother's brother is mama, father's sister is bua, brother's daughter is niece.
So mother's brother is mama. And his son?
His son is your cousin. Uncles' and aunts' children are cousins. A brother shares your parents.
What about 'my father's only son'? Is that my brother?
Fix the speaker first. A boy saying it means himself. A girl means her brother.
Oh! And if the gender isn't given?
Never assume. Use a gender-neutral word like sibling. Otherwise choose cannot be determined.
Any trick to remember all this?
Level, Link, Look. Start from yourself, mark each generation, decode one link at a time, then re-read the question.
